text: im gonna stop you and ask, logically, what are u planning on doing here now. because you just wiped out all the ability to connect anything that isnt one long ass quad, right. now im not saying your wrong but im saying that its not what i would have done. so im just curious what your plan is here next
resolution: Stopped all live mutations and reassessed the bulk deletion against the demonstrated strip workflow. The deletion was not a viable continuation: selecting every tinted render triangle also removed existing authored quads and all intermediate horizontal rails, leaving only the outer boundaries and forcing either giant top-to-bottom quads or reconstruction of rails that had just been discarded. The correct plan is to undo that single deletion, preserve completed quads/rails, and process small triangle-soup patches one at a time—delete N triangles, immediately bridge the exposed top/bottom edges with one quad, then advance laterally and close/weld/normalize only after the wrap.
